Hi, we are a mixed married couple who lives in Spain. my wife is from Honduras and every time we enter Israel they are delaying her in the airport. What can I do in order to avoid that? The embassy says she can enter with no problem. 
The immigration office in Israel says I need to go to the embassy.

We have no intention to live in Israel for now. Just to come for a visit from time to time

Appreciate your answers
